newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanbo firms default on 131 bln won debt.
newsitem.headline: Hanbo firms default on 131 bln won debt.

text.p: Hanbo Steel Co and two of its affiliates defaulted on debt payments totalling 131.1 billion won last week, officials at the Office of Bank Supervision said on Monday.
The affiliates are unlisted firms Hanbo Corp and Hanbo Energy Co Ltd, they said.
"Hanbo Steel defaulted on more loans today but we don't have details yet," one official said.
The officials said Hanbo Steel, flagship of the Hanbo Group, South Korea's 14th largest industrial conglomerate, defaulted on debt totalling 123.9 billion won between Thursday and Saturday.
Hanbo Corp's default totalled 4.5 billion won during the period and Hanbo Energy's 2.7 billion, they added.
Banking analysts said they expected the Hanbo Group's total debt default to exceed 200 billion won.
